releaseNotes:
🎨 Glassmorphic Popups: Stunning new floating windows for Play Queue, Playlists, & Menus.
⚡ Instant Lyrics Engine: Zero-delay lyrics loading with perfect background timing sync.
🎧 Dolby Atmos Support: Native spatial audio with real-time quality badges in the player.
🧑‍🎤 Pure Artist Pages: Strict filtering to show only official artist discographies.
🛠️ UI & Stability Fixes: Solved menu overlaps, queue scrolling, and Python backend crashes.
